question: Do frozen Stage1 v2 phase and causal features add held-out predictive information about expert-minus-Base1000 H15 action residual, beyond the Base action chunk and task identity?
base_output: normalized relative EEF16, H50 predicted, first H15 used
probe_arms: task-one-hot plus frozen Base H15 action
same features plus frozen ZTE phase, previous causal signal, and running causal mean
probe_task_one_hot: diagnostic-only oracle task coordinate included identically in both arms; never proposed for deployment
probe_architecture: same 512-wide LayerNorm-SiLU MLP, unavailable input groups zero-masked
probe_training: 1000 AdamW steps, batch512, lr3e-4, seed1000; no checkpoint selection on validation
probe_metric: held-out validation5 normalized expert-action H15 MSE of Base plus predicted residual
interpretation_gate: A reproducible >=1% relative MSE reduction versus the Base-action-plus-task arm, with >=7 of 10 tasks non-worse, is evidence of incremental representation only; it is not sufficient for Stage2 deployment or closed-loop success. Below that, redesign Stage1/ZTE targets before another ZeVA fine-tune.
deployability_caveat: Both arms are trained on expert states; a positive offline probe must be followed by independent on-policy development evaluation before any new formal 10x20 test.
